Welcome to ONEGOODJUNE. We appreciate your interest in publishing your creative work on our platform. Please read our guidelines for sharing your work.

We accept fiction, poetry, essays, creative nonfiction and events reporting pieces based on Christian or human experiences and the Christian creative space. Please note that we prioritize low-romance fiction and stories based on the experiences of African Christians and the creative industry.

Currently, we do not offer monetary payment for writers to publish their work on our blog site. In the future when we do, such terms will be reflected here. Send your work only if you are fine with not being paid.

Ownership: Ensure you are the owner of any work you send to us. We do not accept pieces written by or with the assistance of AI tools (proofreading with Grammarly is an exception). We don't also accept works already published on other platforms or literary papers.
Quality: Ensure you submit works that have passed two revisions beyond the first draft. We have a very small team and won't take a second look at raw drafts or unpolished pieces.
Length: Submit works from 500 to 3,000 words. No series please, all submissions should be standalone work. Every piece should be submitted separately.

Formatting: All submissions should be in Word Document format (no PDFs), the font should be Crimson Text or Assistant, set to 12pt, spacing should be 1.5 (no double key spacing), no indents, and left justified.
•Your email subject: Creative Submission – Your Name
Visibility Marketing: Every accepted and published work will receive targeted marketing on our social media platforms, writers’ community, and newsletter.
Priority Consideration: Get priority access to our career programs, receive special discounts to paid events, and be on the top list of potential guests for our virtual sessions.
Creative Ambassador Award: Stand a chance to become one of the recipients of our creative ambassadors award in our annual award event.

This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why, how we use and protect it, and the choices and rights you have. We process personal data in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA) and, for visitors in the UK and European Economic Area, the GDPR and UK GDPR.

Under 15. If we learn that we hold personal data from a person under 15, or from a person aged 15 to 17 without verified parental consent, we will delete it promptly. If you believe this has happened, please contact us.
